# Security policy

Email **security@tendstack.com** privately with suspected vulnerabilities. Include
version/commit, affected component, a minimal reproduction and the likely impact.
Do not open a public issue, attach production credentials or include real user data.
We will coordinate disclosure and a fix with the reporter; no response-time SLA
is promised during preview. Sanitized examples are preferable to sensitive logs.

Security fixes currently target the latest TendUI preview. Historical pre-rename
versions are not an actively supported security line. Applications remain
responsible for authentication, request protection and their Go dependencies.

If GitHub private vulnerability reporting is enabled for the repository, its
“Report a vulnerability” form is also an appropriate private channel.
